verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI documents asynchronous transcription of recorded audio and video. Its SDK uploads, submits and polls a file in one call, and a published OpenAPI spec exists. A 20-minute duration cap is published for the synchronous HTTP mode. However, no list of accepted file formats or file-size limits appears in the evidence, and the upload endpoint itself is only implied. missing for 10: published accepted-format list, published file-size limits, explicit documentation of the local-file upload endpoint, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a local audio or video file for transcription through a documented API endpoint, with accepted formats and size limits published

citations.quote: The SDK uploads, submits, and polls for you in a single call.
Transcribes recorded audio and video asynchronously across 99 languages
Transcribes audio up to 20 minutes long over HTTP
